summary: Each activation container has a 200 MB memory limit, enough for about 150,000 events/minute on 4 CPU/16 GB; overload kills it with status 137. Raise it at install with automationedacontroller_podman_mem_limit='400m' in [all:vars], or later with PODMAN_MEM_LIMIT in /etc/ansible-automation-platform/eda/settings.yaml and automation-eda-controller-service restart.
questions: Why did my rulebook activation fail with status 137?
How do I increase memory for rulebook activations?
What is the default memory limit per activation?

answer_card.title: Raise rulebook activation memory limit
answer_card.answer_md:
Default: 200 MB per activation container. Running out of memory kills it with **exit code 137**.

During install, in the inventory `[all:vars]`:
```ini
automationedacontroller_podman_mem_limit='400m'
```
After install, edit `/etc/ansible-automation-platform/eda/settings.yaml`:
```
PODMAN_MEM_LIMIT = '300m'
```
then run `automation-eda-controller-service restart`.
